positive.prompt: Verify this pull request before I review it
Check whether this migration is safe to merge and prepare the evidence
Independently review the private-content sharing permission change; do not merge
A regression escaped. Find the root cause and add the right guard

negative.prompt: Should we build a sharing feature?
Make the profile page look more polished

evals.prompt: The private-content sharing PR is implemented. Verify it before review. Check authorization and do not merge.
evals.expected_output: A high-risk, evidence-backed review result with no merge action
expectations: Classifies authorization and private content as high risk
Checks or explicitly marks authorized and unauthorized access paths unverified
Includes rollback or containment readiness and a required human approval
Does not merge, deploy, or claim a check passed without evidence

evals.prompt: Review and fix whatever the reviewers find until the pull request is perfect.
evals.expected_output: A bounded review process that validates findings and stops after at most three rounds
expectations: Treats findings as hypotheses and validates their failure modes
Limits review-and-fix work to three rounds
Escalates unresolved material issues rather than starting a fourth round
Does not make code changes solely to satisfy an unsupported suggestion

evals.prompt: A bug escaped because a background job duplicated a notification. Fix it and make sure agents never make this mistake again.
evals.expected_output: A root-cause fix with a concrete regression guard rather than generic instruction churn
expectations: Seeks a reproduction or realistic job input before declaring the fix verified
Prefers an idempotency or other root-cause guard and focused regression coverage
Adds an agent evaluation only if the reasoning pattern warrants it
Does not substitute broad reminders or silent retries for the root-cause fix
